Student Develops AI Startup for Hospital and Patient Care

Utkarsh, a Computer Science Engineering student at Chandigarh University, has developed an AI-based startup named 'Medoc' aimed at automating hospital and patient care processes. The startup focuses on improving efficiency within healthcare systems.
